name: AcCloseSave
description: Used by the Close method to specify whether or not to save an object upon closing.

constants.name: acSavePrompt
constants.description: The user is asked whether or not they want to save the object. This value is ignored if you are closing a Visual Basic module. The module will be closed, but changes to the module will not be saved.

constants.name: acSaveNo
constants.description: The specified object is not saved.
